about: The cast of the Marco Polo lesson. Looks are copied from the History Lines skill (bart, 24-26 Nov 2026). A sheet is null until bart approves one; palette colours are sampled from the approved colour sheet with `shots.py palette`, never typed in by hand.

marco.name: Marco Polo
marco.look: Marco is 17: young and beardless, shoulder-length chestnut hair, white linen tunic with a lace at the neck, brown belt, brown satchel on a strap, brown leggings, soft boots. In snow: a white fur-lined coat over the same. White is his colour; no one else in this lesson wears white.
marco.tell: 17, beardless, shoulder-length chestnut hair, white tunic, no cloak

niccolo.name: Niccolò Polo (Marco's father)
niccolo.look: Marco's father, clearly the oldest. Broad square face, heavy brows, wide nose, lined forehead, full rounded grey beard, warm steady look. Hair grey. Cream under-tunic, rust-orange cap, red cloak with a gold clasp.
niccolo.tell: oldest, broad square face, full rounded grey beard, rust-orange cap, red cloak

maffeo.name: Maffeo Polo (Marco's uncle)
maffeo.look: The uncle with the sharp eyes, younger-looking than Niccolò and never like him. Long narrow face, high cheekbones, thin slightly hooked nose, keen narrow eyes, short trimmed pointed beard, near-black. Hair near-black, cropped short. Cream under-tunic, blue cap, blue cloak with a gold clasp, in every picture. No one else wears a blue cap.
maffeo.tell: long narrow face, short pointed near-black beard, blue cap, blue cloak

marco-horse.name: Marco's horse
marco-horse.look: A smaller, lively, compact chestnut: red-brown, lighter mane, a white blaze and one white sock on the left hind. A small, sturdy horse of the region (13 to 14 hands), never a big European warhorse.
marco-horse.tell: the smallest, compact red-brown horse with a blaze and one white hind sock

niccolo-horse.name: Niccolò's horse
niccolo-horse.look: A black horse with the same build and size as Marco's chestnut (bart, Nov 26: the bay was too small): black coat, black mane and tail, only a small, faint, irregular natural white patch on the forehead. A small, sturdy horse of the region (13 to 14 hands), never a big European warhorse.
niccolo-horse.tell: the black horse, built like the chestnut

maffeo-horse.name: Maffeo's horse
maffeo-horse.look: A lean, long-necked dapple grey with a dark muzzle and darker legs. A small, sturdy horse of the region (13 to 14 hands), never a big European warhorse.
maffeo-horse.tell: the lean long-necked dapple grey with a dark muzzle

kublai.name: Kublai Khan
kublai.look: The Great Khan, about 51 in 1266. Polo: 'neither tall nor short', 'complexion white and red, the eyes black'. A broad round face, a thin moustache and a small chin beard, a sturdy build. A long robe of dark gold silk with a fur-trimmed collar, a broad belt, a fur-trimmed Mongol hat. Seated on a throne in every shot he is in.
kublai.tell: the seated ruler in dark gold silk with a fur-trimmed hat
